CREATE TABLE live_control_audit (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	transition_id VARCHAR(36), 
	action VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	detail JSONB NOT NULL, 
	at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE live_control_devices (
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	key_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	capabilities JSONB NOT NULL, 
	key_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	sequence_reserved BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	command_sequence BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	command_acknowledged BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	effective_profile VARCHAR(64), 
	reported_profile VARCHAR(64), 
	effective_event VARCHAR(36), 
	pending_transition VARCHAR(36), 
	effective_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_request_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (device_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_live_counter CHECK (key_epoch>0 AND sequence_reserved>=0 AND sequence_reserved<=4294967295 AND command_sequence>=0 AND command_acknowledged>=0)
)


CREATE TABLE live_control_leases (
	request_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	boot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	body JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_live_boot_lease UNIQUE (device_id, boot_id)
)


CREATE TABLE live_control_workers (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE live_control_transitions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	old_profile VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	target_profile VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	correlation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	deadline TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	activated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	telemetry_event VARCHAR(36), 
	error VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES live_control_devices (device_id), 
	UNIQUE (correlation_id)
)


CREATE TABLE live_control_commands (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	transition_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	command_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	body JSONB NOT NULL, 
	wire VARCHAR(8192), 
	status VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	available_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	claim VARCHAR(36), 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_live_command_sequence UNIQUE (device_id, command_epoch, sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_live_transition_phase UNIQUE (transition_id, phase), 
	FOREIGN KEY(transition_id) REFERENCES live_control_transitions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE live_control_acks (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	body JSONB NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (command_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(command_id) REFERENCES live_control_commands (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_live_control_history ON live_control_audit (device_id, at)
CREATE INDEX ix_live_command_delivery ON live_control_commands (status, available_at)
